senses.gloss:
अमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Unmeasured, boundless, infinite.
 2. Neglected,
unpolished, unclean.
 E. अ neg. मित measured.

अमितौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Mighty, all-powerful, almighty.
 E. अमित
boundless, ओजस् strength.

अमित्र m. (-त्रः) An enemy, an adversary.
 mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Unfriendly,
hostile.
 E. अम् to go, and इत्र Unādi affix, or अ neg. and मित्र a
friend.

अमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Sick, diseased.
 E. अम sickness, इनि aff.

अमिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Unmixed, unmixing.
 E. अ neg. मिश्र mixture.

अमिश्रणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Immiscible.
 E. अ neg. मिश्रणीय to be mixed.

अमिश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unmixed.
 E. अ neg. मिश्रित mixed.

अमिष n. (-षं)
 1. Luxury.
 2. Honesty, simplicity.
 E. अम to be sick, इषन्
Unādi aff.

आमिष mn. (-षः-षं)
 1. Flesh.
 2. Enjoyment.
 3. An object of enjoyment,
a pleasing or beautiful object, &c.
 4. A bribe.
 5. Coveting, longing
for.
 6. Form.
 7. Lust, desire.
 8. Food.
 E. अम् to be sick, to go, ष्टिसच्
Unādi aff. and the antepen. lengthened.

अमीमांसा f. (-सा) Absence of reasoning or investigation.
 E. अ neg. मीमांसा
investigation by reason.

आमिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Curd of two milk whey.
 E. आङ् before मिष to sprinkle,
सक् affix; also आमीक्षा.

आमिषप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Carnivorous, fond of flesh meat.
 m. (-यः) A
heron.
 E. आमिष flesh, and प्रिय fond of.

आमिषभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Carnivorous.
 E. आमिष and भुज what eats.

आमिषाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Carnivorous, eating flesh and fish.
 E. आमिष
flesh, अश to eat, and णिनि aff.
